scope: Closed-set restore and last-good transaction only
inputs: Four previously qualified checkpoint byte hashes and persisted engine/data/patient/configuration bindings
native_matrix: Four checkpoints, horizons 0/1/50/500/3000 ticks, original relative threshold 1e-9
last_good_policy: No live Pulse engine in parent
Disposable candidate child; exact validated input bytes on stdin
Advance observed outputs does not create a new restorable checkpoint
Persist pointer to original qualified input only after all outputs pass
Preserve pointer byte-for-byte on refusals or child failures
Per-output-root exclusive lock; no automatic removal of a stale lock
Atomic same-directory pointer replace after validation
test_boundaries: Native successes use pinned Pulse. Exit/timeout/bad-output tests use clearly labelled synthetic child fixtures; no physiological result from those fixtures
limits: No process-tree or sandbox guarantee beyond the direct worker child
